title: Owned-care brand — provisional CaseMap
paying_customer: Assumption: US adult paying cash. Numeric map uses weight management only to keep direct rivals comparable; no niche selected.
our_offer: Proposed branded access to licensed clinical care with understandable costs and next steps; independent clinicians determine treatment.

needs_intake.method: Public offer research plus buyer hypotheses; no patient interviews or willingness-to-pay evidence.
needs_intake.latent_hunt: What could cause refusal despite price/speed? Surprise renewal, unclear handoff owner, inability to leave, health-data exposure.
needs_intake.limitation: Scores concern public buying-process posture and design targets, never clinical quality.

customer_needs.need: Understand independent evaluation and no guaranteed prescription
customer_needs.job_to_be_done: Understand independent evaluation and no guaranteed prescription

customer_needs.need: See personal 90-day spending scenarios and next steps with change triggers
customer_needs.job_to_be_done: See personal 90-day spending scenarios and next steps with change triggers

customer_needs.need: Know financial consequences of ineligibility or stopping
customer_needs.job_to_be_done: Know financial consequences of ineligibility or stopping

customer_needs.need: Know who owns delayed refills, labs and clinical handoffs
customer_needs.job_to_be_done: Know who owns delayed refills, labs and clinical handoffs

customer_needs.need: Avoid health information being treated as ordinary ad-lead data
customer_needs.job_to_be_done: Avoid health information being treated as ordinary ad-lead data

customer_needs.need: Choose care without shame or pressure to obtain a named drug
customer_needs.job_to_be_done: Choose care without shame or pressure to obtain a named drug

industry_value_adds.value_add: Readable personal record of quoted costs, next action and responsible team
Owned marketing platform and sophisticated media buying
industry_value_adds.notes: Potential business capability, not evidence of better patient care.

competitors.name: Ro Body
competitors.business_model: Membership plus medication, insurance concierge and prepaid options.
competitors.sells_to: Adults seeking clinician-managed weight treatment, subject to eligibility.
competitors.why_face: Same illustrative US adult cash-pay weight-management service class. No venture niche chosen.
competitors.exclusive_vs_shared: Not applicable: clinical care, not lead resale.
competitors.trust_scars: Hypothesis: combining charges/plan terms increases comparison effort; not evidence of poor care.

competitors.name: Mochi Health
competitors.business_model: Membership plus medication and diagnostic charges; self-pay and insurance routes.
competitors.sells_to: People seeking clinician-managed weight treatment; this map concerns adults.
competitors.why_face: Same illustrative US adult cash-pay weight-management service class.
competitors.exclusive_vs_shared: Not applicable: clinical care, not lead resale.
competitors.trust_scars: Hypothesis: membership/medication/lab components require combining; not a finding of deceptive billing.

ro.rationale: Membership and medication separated; necessary labs described in membership.

mochi.rationale: Membership, medication and diagnostic exclusions expressly separated.

ro.rationale: Published $39 first month and $149 monthly renewal; annual-plan option distinguished.

mochi.rationale: Published $0 first monthly membership then $79; longer-plan option distinguished.

us.rationale: Independent clinician review proposed; no partner contracted in this analysis.

ro.rationale: Eligibility and personalized provider care described.

mochi.rationale: Video evaluation and prescribing only if appropriate described.

us.rationale: Coverage and escalation not confirmed; planning prior only.

ro.rationale: On-demand provider support, messaging and regular check-ins advertised.

mochi.rationale: Unlimited self-pay visits and 24/7 care team advertised; not equivalent clinician-access promises.

us.rationale: Stretch target: personal cost/next-step record with change triggers.

ro.rationale: Neutral prior: reviewed public page cannot establish personalized receipt capability.

mochi.rationale: Neutral prior: reviewed public page cannot establish personalized receipt capability.

us.rationale: Policy not agreed; parity prior, not evidence of protection.

mochi.rationale: Ineligibility-specific refund not established from reviewed homepage; neutral prior, not weakness finding.

totals_warning: Unweighted workshop sums, not a ranking of actual care. Mixed-confidence cells and future targets are not comparable measured performance.

main_strength.explanation: Make the financial/clinical journey legible. Price clarity and support already exist at competitors.

breakers.tier_1_model_blocked: None documented. No exclusive clinical access, unique drug rights, superior outcomes or hard-to-copy moat established.
tier_2_copyable: Clinician-approved plan plus personal financial scenario receipt with uncertainty ranges.
Separate consultations, drugs, labs, shipping, renewal and cancellation fields.
Named handoff owner, change notifications and documented escalation.
breakers.test: Remove receipt, change notices and response ownership: does candidate Focus disappear? Validate comprehension and actual handoff delivery.
breakers.clinical_gate: Marketing software does not choose medicines or doses; no implied prescription guarantee.

give_ups.detail: No launch segment or clinical/product path selected.
give_ups.reallocate_to: Flexible identity and evidence-grounded service pages.

give_ups.detail: Dose, labs, shipping and care scope change actual spending.
give_ups.reallocate_to: Itemization, scenario ranges and change notifications.

give_ups.detail: Bounded pilot after clinical/commercial validation; not a menopause mandate.
give_ups.reallocate_to: One understandable journey and support ownership.

give_ups.aspect: Rebuild clinical backend before demand proof
give_ups.detail: MyDose and medical infrastructure are potential attach partners, not face rivals.
give_ups.reallocate_to: Contracts/export diligence and visible patient process.

give_ups.detail: Brand ownership and media expertise do not establish better medicine.
give_ups.reallocate_to: Clinically reviewed factual education and evidence register.

give_ups.detail: Hone already advertises biomarker-led longevity breadth; theatre is not a moat.
give_ups.reallocate_to: Decision clarity and operational trust artifacts.

claims.claim: Understand the plan and what could change before committing.
claims.breaker_test: Without personalized receipt and change triggers this is generic copy, not an earned claim.

peers_already_match: Ro/Mochi publish costs/exclusions and renewal terms.
Ro publishes support and ineligibility refund.
Mochi advertises self-pay provider visits and care team.
Hone publishes testing/follow-up; Evernow publishes ongoing menopause messaging.
hard_to_match: None demonstrated. An audited operational record could become evidence, not automatically a moat.

attach_partners.role: Medical/dispensing/testing duties require contracts, not just brand ownership.

attach_partners.role: Potential B2B buildout/marketing vendor, not patient-facing competitor.

adjacent.name: Hone

adjacent.role: Menopause benchmark; replace face set if menopause chosen.

speakable: A flexible care brand built around clear decisions, costs and next steps—not a promise of better medicine.

framework: Discover customer needs and industry value-adds, including latent needs
Select 5–8 scored attributes traced to needs
Score Us vs 2–4 face competitors, 1–5, evidence/confidence per cell
Identify Focus and Breaker with moat honesty
Persist YAML and readable Markdown, plus Canvas graphic
